title: IHF AEGING GFAP + Iba1 + NeuN
author: Aroa S. Maroto
materials: Bring the VECTASHIELD® HardSet™ to room temperature.
You have your slices ready for the microscope

steps.title: Select slices and submerge
steps.instruction: Choose the tissue slices, place one slice per 2 ml tube containing citrate solution, and ensure each slice is completely submerged.

steps.title: Heat retrieval in thermoblock
steps.instruction: Put the tubes in a thermoblock set to 80 °C for 20 minutes; gentle shaking is not required.

steps.title: Block tissue slices
steps.instruction: Transfer the slices to a multi‑well plate (≈3 slices per well) and add 500 µl per well of blocking buffer; incubate at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare primary antibody dilutions
steps.instruction: Dilute primary antibodies in antibody diluent as follows: GFAP 1:1000, NeuN 1:1000, Iba1 1:5000.

steps.title: Incubate with primary antibodies
steps.instruction: Add 500 µl per well of the prepared primary‑antibody mixture to each well and incubate overnight at 4 °C with gentle shaking.

steps.title: Wash after primary incubation
steps.instruction: Remove the primary‑antibody solution, then wash the slices with 500 µl per well of wash buffer for 5 minutes; repeat this wash three times, ensuring the tissue is fully covered each time.

steps.title: Prepare secondary antibody dilutions
steps.instruction: Dilute secondary antibodies in appropriate diluent as follows: Anti‑Chicken 488 (for GFAP) 1:500, Anti‑Mouse 555 (for NeuN) 1:500, Anti‑Rabbit 647 (for Iba1) 1:500.

steps.title: Incubate with secondary antibodies
steps.instruction: Add 500 µl per well of the secondary‑antibody mixture to each well and incubate at room temperature with gentle shaking.

steps.title: Wash after secondary incubation
steps.instruction: Add 500 µl per well of wash buffer, shake for 5 minutes, then remove the buffer; repeat this wash at least three times.

steps.title: Stain with DAPI
steps.instruction: Add 500 µl per well of DAPI solution, incubate at room temperature with gentle shaking for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Final washes after DAPI
steps.instruction: Wash the slices with 500 µl per well of wash buffer, shaking for 5 minutes and removing the buffer; repeat the wash at least three times, then remove any residual DAPI.

steps.title: Mount slices with Vectashield
steps.instruction: Place each slice on a microscope slide, add approximately 50 µl of VECTASHIELD® HardSet™ per slice, cover with a cover slip, put the slide in a dark box and allow it to dry.
